lobby.games.none_create.note: Game list: empty, and this player may create a game there.

lobby.games.playing.note: Game list, lower case after a dot on a game's row: the game has started.

lobby.games.saved.text: The game was saved. Continue it from this list later.

lobby.games.saves.note: Game list: heading over the games saved on this server.

lobby.games.title.note: A server's game list: the screen's title.

lobby.join.note: Button on a game's row in the LAN list or a server's game list: take a seat at that game.

lobby.lan.address.note: LAN screen: label of the field for a host's IP address.

lobby.lan.in_progress.note: LAN screen, a found game's row, after a dot: the game has started.

lobby.lan.none.text: No games found yet. Still looking…

lobby.lan.on_network.note: LAN screen: heading over the list of games found on the local network.

lobby.lost.text: Lost the connection to the server.
lobby.lost.note: Status line on the LAN or Online screen, or the Connection lost dialog, when the server connection dropped.

lobby.nickname.note: Label of the player's name field on the first start and on the Host, LAN and Online screens.

lobby.online.down.note: Online screen: status beside a Recent server that did not answer.

lobby.online.recent.note: Online screen: heading over the servers joined before.

lobby.options.ban_rounds.note: Table screen, setup summary. n: rounds of character bans.

lobby.options.draft.note: Table screen, setup summary: characters are drafted. n: characters each player picks from.

lobby.options.no_bonus_souls.note: Table screen, setup summary, lower case after a dot: the game plays without bonus souls.

lobby.options.random.note: Table screen, setup summary: each player gets a random character.

lobby.options.rollback_soft.note: Game list and table screen: the game's rollback mode; the others vote on each undo.

lobby.options.timer.note: Table screen, setup summary: the response timer. n: seconds a player has to answer.

lobby.rejoin.note: LAN screen: button on a started game where this app held a seat; takes the seat back.

lobby.seats.addresses.note: Table screen: screen-reader name of the host's address list.

lobby.seats.away.note: Table screen, lower case after a dot: the player lost the connection.

lobby.seats.back.note: Table screen of a saved game, lower case after a dot: the player came back.

lobby.seats.is_ready.note: Table screen: at the right of a seat whose player is ready.

lobby.seats.join_at.note: Table screen, for the host: heading over this computer's addresses.

lobby.seats.leave.note: Table screen: button that leaves the seat.

lobby.seats.not_back.note: Table screen of a saved game, lower case after a dot: the player has not come back.

lobby.seats.not_ready.note: Table screen: the same button once pressed; takes the ready back.

lobby.seats.ready.note: Table screen: button; the player is ready to start.

lobby.seats.saved_hint.text: The saved game goes on when everyone is back and ready.
lobby.seats.saved_hint.note: Table screen: line under the seats of a saved game.

lobby.seats.saved_title.note: Table screen title: the seats before a saved game goes on.

lobby.seats.seats.note: Table screen: screen-reader name of the seat list.

lobby.seats.title.note: Table screen title: the seats before a new game starts.

lobby.seats.you.note: Table screen: after the viewer's own name on their seat.

look.hand_of.note: Look dialog: heading over cards from another player's hand.

look.ok.note: Look dialog: button that closes it.

look.title.note: Dialog title over the cards an effect lets the player look at.

look.your_hand.note: Look dialog: heading over cards from the viewer's own hand.

lost.leave.note: Connection lost dialog: button that leaves the game.

lost.reconnect.note: Connection lost dialog: button that tries again.

lost.reconnecting.note: Game table: small badge while the app reconnects by itself.

lost.reconnecting_label.note: Game table: screen-reader name of the small badge while the app reconnects.

lost.restarting.note: Game table: small badge while the server restarts.

lost.text.text: Your seat waits for you. The others may vote to go on without you.

lost.title.note: Dialog title when the game connection dropped for a while.

mat.basement.note: Settings: the Basement game mat in the Game mat list (an image, or brown colors without it). Named after the Isaac floor.

mat.cathedral.note: Settings: the Cathedral game mat in the Game mat list (an image, or pale blue colors without it). Named after the Isaac floor.

menu.exit.note: Main menu: button that closes the app.

menu.lan.note: Main menu button (play on the local network) and the LAN screen's title; also after a dot in the Rejoin button.

menu.learn.note: Main menu: a greyed button for the tutorial, still to come.

menu.online.note: Main menu button (play on an internet server) and the Online screen's title; also after a dot in the Rejoin button.

menu.play.note: Main menu: button that opens the LAN / Online / Learn to play group under it.

menu.records.note: Main menu: a greyed button for watching saved match records, still to come.

menu.rejoin.note: Main menu, corner button: go back to the game this app left. game: 'Ann's game · LAN' or 'your game'.

menu.rejoin_host.note: Main menu, inside the Rejoin button: the game to go back to. host: the host's name.

menu.rejoin_yours.note: Main menu, inside the Rejoin button, lower case: the game to go back to when its host is unknown.

menu.settings.note: Main menu: button that opens the settings screen.

menu.soon.note: Main menu: small tag on a greyed button for a feature still to come.

menu.soon_label.note: Main menu: screen-reader name of a greyed button. name: the button's text, e.g. Records.

menu.versions.note: Main menu, bottom corner: version numbers. app: the app's version; engine: the rules engine's.

notice.engine_updated.text.text: The game goes on with a newer rules engine. Some cards may behave differently now.
notice.engine_updated.text.note: Server notice dialog text under 'The server was updated'.

notice.engine_updated.title.note: Server notice dialog title: the server restarted with a new rules engine; the game goes on.

notice.game_idle.idle.text: Nobody played it for too long.
notice.game_idle.idle.note: Server notice dialog text: the game sat idle.

notice.game_idle.long.text: It ran for 24 hours, the longest a game may run.
notice.game_idle.long.note: Server notice dialog text: the game hit the time limit.

notice.game_idle.title.note: Server notice dialog title: the server closed a game that ran too long or sat idle.

notice.ok.note: Server notice dialog: button that closes it.

notice.title.note: Server notice dialog title for a notice this app does not know; its code shows under it.

order.hint.text: Click the cards top first. Click a placed card to take it back.
order.hint.note: Dialog that puts cards back on a deck in an order: the hint.

order.not_placed.note: Order dialog: screen-reader name of the cards not placed yet.

order.place.note: Order dialog: screen-reader name of a place on the deck. n: from the top, from 1.

order.put_back.note: Order dialog: button that puts the cards back in the chosen order.

order.top.note: Order dialog: under the first place, the deck's top.

over.hint.text: Keep the match record to watch it again later.
over.hint.note: Game over dialog: line under the title.

over.menu.note: Game over dialog: button back to the main menu.

over.save.note: Game over dialog: button that saves the match record to a file.

over.saved.note: Game over dialog: status after saving the record. path: the file.

over.title.note: Game over dialog: title with no winner, and its screen-reader name.

over.win.note: Game over dialog title with several winners. players: all but the last, comma-separated; last: the last winner.

over.wins.note: Game over dialog title. player: the winner.

over.you_win.note: Game over dialog title: the viewer won.

pause.kick.note: Pause dialog: button; vote to go on without them.

pause.left.text: They left the game. Wait for them to come back, or go on without them.

pause.restarted.text: The server restarted. The others are coming back.
pause.restarted.note: Pause dialog after a server restart.

pause.title.note: Pause dialog title. players: who left, comma-separated.

pause.vote_kick.note: Pause dialog, a player's vote, lower case after 'Ann:'.

pause.vote_wait.note: Pause dialog, a player's vote, lower case after 'Ann:'.

pause.wait.note: Pause dialog: button; vote to wait for the players who left.

rollback.ask.other.note: Rollback vote panel title: a player asked to undo their own move.

rollback.ask.you.text: You ask to undo a move
rollback.ask.you.note: Rollback vote panel title: the viewer asked to undo their own move.

rollback.cancel.note: Rollback vote panel, for whoever opened it: button that cancels the vote.

rollback.needed.note: Rollback vote panel: the count. yes: yes votes so far; n: yes votes needed.

rollback.no.note: Rollback vote panel: button; vote no.

rollback.undoes.note: Rollback vote panel: what the vote undoes. move: the move, e.g. 'Bo plays A Penny!'; n: steps undone.

rollback.voted_no.note: Rollback vote panel, a player's vote, lower case after 'Ann:'.

rollback.voted_yes.note: Rollback vote panel, a player's vote, lower case after 'Ann:'.

rollback.want.other.note: Rollback vote panel title. player: who opened the vote; author: whose move.

rollback.want.you.note: Rollback vote panel title: the viewer opened a vote on another player's move. author: whose move.

rollback.want.yours.note: Rollback vote panel title: a player opened a vote on the viewer's move.

rollback.yes.note: Rollback vote panel: button; vote yes.

rollback.you.note: Rollback vote panel: the viewer in the list of votes.

set.base_game.note: Card set name: host screen check boxes and the game list. Use the name the print in your language uses.

set.four_souls_plus.note: Card set name: host screen check boxes and the game list. Use the name the print in your language uses.

set.gold_box.note: Card set name: host screen check boxes and the game list. Use the name the print in your language uses.

set.requiem.note: Card set name: host screen check boxes and the game list. Use the name the print in your language uses.

settings.animations.note: Settings: label of the animation speed list.

settings.back.note: Settings: button back to the main menu, without saving.

settings.dice.note: Settings: label of the list of dice looks.

settings.dice_preview.note: Settings: screen-reader name of the six dice faces in the picked look.

settings.dice_set.holy.note: Settings: heading of a group in the Dice list (the dice of the Holy set: Tear, The Bible, …).

settings.dice_set.unholy.note: Settings: heading of a group in the Dice list (the dice of the Unholy set: Brimstone, Poop, …).

settings.end_turn_ask.text: Ask before ending the turn while plays are left
settings.end_turn_ask.note: Settings: checkbox. On, End turn asks first when the player could still attack, buy or play.

settings.fullscreen.note: Settings: checkbox for a fullscreen window.

settings.language.note: Settings: label of the language list. Each language shows in its own name.

settings.mat.note: Settings: label of the list of mats under the game table.

settings.mat_preview.note: Settings: screen-reader name of the picture of the picked mat.

settings.nickname.note: Settings: label of the player's name field.

settings.save.note: Settings: button that saves every setting on the screen.

settings.saved.note: Settings: status line after Save worked.

settings.speed.normal.note: Settings: animation speed choice; the default.

settings.speed.off.note: Settings: animation speed choice: no animations.

stack.a_card.note: Stack line, history line or a player's activity: a card whose name the viewer can't see.

stack.a_monster.note: Stack panel or a player's activity: an attacked monster whose name is unknown.

stack.ability.note: Stack line: a card's ability. card: the card; player: whose it is.

stack.attack.note: Stack line of an attack's roll or damage. line: the rest of the line, e.g. 'Ann rolls 4 against Gaper'.

stack.damage.note: Stack line: damage a player deals. n: the damage; target: what it hits.

stack.damage_by_card.note: Stack line: damage a card (a monster, an item) deals. n: the damage; target: what it hits.

stack.damage_to.note: Stack line: damage from an unknown source. n: the damage; target: what it hits.

stack.declared.attack.note: Stack panel, top row: the active player declared an attack and picks its target.

stack.declared.attack_deck.note: Stack panel, top row: the active player attacks the top of the monster deck.

stack.declared.attack_target.note: Stack panel, top row: an open attack. target: the monster or player attacked.

stack.declared.buy.note: Stack panel, top row: the active player declared a purchase.

stack.declared.end_turn.note: Stack panel, top row: the active player declared the end of the turn.

stack.dies.note: Stack line: a death waiting to resolve. target: the player or monster.

stack.empty.note: Stack panel: the stack is empty.

stack.killed.note: Stack line: a card being killed.

stack.last_roll.note: Stack panel: screen-reader name of the small die by the title.

stack.loot.note: Stack line: a loot card being played. player: in their color; card: the card.

stack.pass.note: Stack panel: button that passes priority.

stack.pass_tip.note: Stack panel: tooltip of Pass. Space is the keyboard key.

stack.passed.note: Stack panel, under the items. players: who passed, comma-separated.

stack.passed_label.note: Stack panel: screen-reader name of the line of players who passed.

stack.penalty.note: Stack line: a dead player's penalty waiting to resolve.

stack.played.note: Under the stack: caption of another player's loot card shown large. player: their name, in their color.

stack.played_label.note: Under the stack: screen-reader name of that large card. player: the player; card: the card's name.

stack.roll.note: Stack line: a roll before its throw.

stack.roll_against.note: Stack line: an attack roll before its throw. target: the monster or player attacked.

stack.roll_against_n.note: Stack line: a thrown attack roll. roll: the die; target: the monster or player attacked.

stack.roll_card.note: Stack line: a card's roll before its throw. card: the card that rolls.

stack.roll_card_n.note: Stack line: a card's thrown roll. roll: the die; card: the card that rolls.

stack.roll_label.note: Stack line: a roll before its throw. label: what it is for, from the server.

stack.roll_label_n.note: Stack line: a thrown roll. roll: the die; label: what it is for, from the server.

stack.roll_n.note: Stack line: a thrown roll. roll: the die, or in the history '3 → 5 (+2 Meat!)'.

stack.roll_result.note: Stack line, after a thrown roll: what changes it and the result. changes: '+1 Meat!, −2 Round Worm'; n: the result.

stack.something.note: Stack line of an item of an unknown kind.

stack.takes_damage.note: Stack line: a player takes damage from their own effect. n: the damage.

stack.title.note: Game table: title of the stack panel on the board (the cards and rolls waiting to resolve).

stack.trigger.note: Stack line: a card's triggered ability.

stack.waiting.note: Stack panel, under the items. players: who may still respond, comma-separated; the viewer is You.

stack.waiting_label.note: Stack panel: screen-reader name of the line that says whom the stack waits for.

stack.you.note: Stack panel: the viewer in the Waiting for and Passed lines.

stats.attack_rolls.note: Zoomed card, under it: changes to its attack rolls. list: the changes with their cards.

stats.attacked.note: Zoomed card, under it: changes to the dice of monsters its player attacks. list: '+1 DC Meat!'.

stats.cant_hit.note: Stack panel, an open attack's fight line: no die face hits.

stats.dc.note: The dice a monster needs to be hit, in the stat sums: '+1 DC Meat!'. Use the print's short form.

stats.effect.atk.note: Tooltip of an effect icon on a card. amount: '+1' or '−1'.

stats.effect.attack_roll.note: Tooltip of an effect icon on a character. amount: '+1' or '−1'.

stats.effect.attacked_dc.note: Tooltip of an effect icon on a character. amount: '+1' or '−1'.

stats.effect.dc.note: Tooltip of an effect icon on a monster. amount: '+1' or '−1'.

stats.effect.hp.note: Tooltip of an effect icon on a card. amount: '+1' or '−1'.

stats.effect.next_attack_roll.note: Tooltip of an effect icon with a small die on a character. amount: '+1' or '−1'.

stats.effect.roll.note: Tooltip of an effect icon on a character. amount: '+1' or '−1'.

stats.hidden_card.note: A stat source or roll change whose card the viewer can't see.

stats.hits_from.note: Stack panel, an open attack's fight line. n: the lowest die face that hits.

stats.hits_on.note: Stack panel, an open attack's fight line. faces: the die faces that hit, '2, 3'.

stats.next_roll.note: In brackets after a stat change: it waits for the next roll.

stats.odds_atk.note: Stack panel, an open attack's fight line, after a dot: the attacker's attack.

stats.odds_atk_sum.note: Stack panel, an open attack's fight line, after a dot. n: attack now; base: printed; terms: ' + 1 Champion Belt'.

stats.odds_hit.note: Stack panel, an open attack's fight line. hits: 'Hits on 4+'; dc: the monster's dice; terms: ' − 1 Meat!'.

stats.rolls.note: Zoomed card, under it: changes to all its player's rolls. list: '+1 Meat!, −2 Round Worm (next roll)'.

stats.sum_atk.note: Zoomed card, under it: why its attack changed. n: attack now; base: printed; terms: the changes with their cards.

stats.sum_dc.note: Zoomed monster, under it: why its dice changed. n: dice now; base: printed; terms: the changes with their cards.

stats.sum_hp.note: Zoomed card, under it: why its health changed. n: max health now; base: printed; terms: '+ 1 Cancer + 1 Polyphemus (this turn)'.

stats.this_turn.note: In brackets after a stat change: it lasts until the turn ends.

stats.this_turn_effect.note: Tooltip of an effect icon on a card. effect: '+1 ATK'.

table.allowance.note: Game table: screen-reader name of the Loot · Attacks · Shop counts.

table.asked.text: The game waits for this player
table.asked.note: Game table: screen-reader name of the hourglass by a player's name.

table.attacks_left.note: Game table, by another active player's name: attacks left this turn.

table.cents.note: Game table: screen-reader name of a player's coin count. n: their cents.

table.curses_of.note: Game table: screen-reader name of another player's curses.

table.dead.note: Game table: tag by a dead player's name, lower case.

table.items_of.note: Game table: screen-reader name of another player's items.

table.your_curses.note: Game table: screen-reader name of the viewer's curses.
